parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck are internally consistent and match the specification's intended power architecture, isolated pH/EC channels, unisolated EZO-RTD on the main I2C bus, TMC2209 driver wiring, pump/valve switching, and protection components. Remaining discrepancies (firmware GPIO mismatch, TF-Luna not wired, DNP environmental sensors, and some spec wording about T3/T5 roles) are either documented as known limitations or are explained by the actual connectivity in the files, so no unsupported anomaly is present.
